skill.name: web-scraper
skill.description: Extract structured data from a URL using CSS selectors. Returns JSON.
skill.body:
# Web Scraper
When the user wants data from a webpage, call `scrape_page` with the URL and CSS selectors. Return clean JSON.
## Rules
- Respect robots/terms; do not scrape login-walled private data.
- Prefer specific selectors over broad ones.
- Return null for missing fields; never invent values.
## Example
User: Get title and price → scrape_page({ url, selectors: { title: 'h1', price: '.price' } })

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: Fetch a URL and extract text via CSS selectors
tools.handler: const r = await fetch(input.url); const html = await r.text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html'); const out = {}; for (const k in input.selectors) { const el = doc.querySelector(input.selectors[k]); out[k] = el ? el.textContent.trim() : null; } return JSON.stringify(out);
